patient_identity.statement: Family7 affected girl aged12years; sibling of male15-year proband7–24.

genotype.statement: Homozygous RPGRIP1c.1216del/p.Leu406Tyrfs*36 explicitly reported in both siblings; panel identified variant in boy after negative mutation microarray and Sanger confirmed sister.
limitations: Exact NM_020366.4/GRCh38genomic coordinate and normalization are not printed in source. Source prose calls deleted base guanine; genomic packet usesC. Strand/reference equivalence not independently established; coding/protein identity matches and no coordinate repair invented.

segregation.statement: Both affected siblings reported homozygous; both unaffected parents and unaffected sister shown as carriers in Figure1. Figure3j directly displays7–23, one unspecified heterozygous parent and control traces.

phase.statement: Homozygosity in affected siblings with both parents carriers supports recessive biallelic inheritance; no compound-heterozygous phase ambiguity.

causal_confidence.statement: Novel homozygous frameshift segregates with severe early retinal disease in two siblings and fits reported RPGRIP1-associated LCA6.
limitations: Protein truncation/NMD inferred, no variant-specific RNA/protein functional test. Same-family recurrence is not two unrelated confirmations.
Heterozygous GUCY2Dc.262C>A/p.Pro88Thr coexists in boy NGS result; no second allele, functional proof or established modifying effect. Do not assign this unshown result to sister.
Study selects22molecularly confirmed families from44tested/51referred; complete molecular confirmation in this subset is not100%diagnostic yield in all referrals.
